marking.appearance_status: Family and voltage text are illustrative; the physical marking, typeface, placement and variable production details are unverified.

recipe.appearance_status: KiCad SOT-223 model has 7.0 x 6.5 x 1.7 mm overall bounds. Source lists 10 x 5 mm without a defined reference, differing from the model. The source uses AMS1117-ADJ; the manufacturer data sheet lists the adjustable SOT-223 as AMS1117. Pin marker and appearance are illustrative; not a verified mechanical model or footprint.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
